subject: Pilot milepost approvals and finance clearance for Q3 ramp
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@bluebayanalytics.com>
Cc: gv-contracts@bluebayanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot mileposts & preliminary commercial outline

Hi Carmen —

Good to meet last week. Per our conversation I attached a concise pilot milestone plan and an initial quote for the evaluation period. High level: a 6‑week pilot (security review, integration week, 3 weeks of evaluation, final acceptance) with a Q3 ramp commitment if KPIs are met.

Ask: BlueBay indicated interest in a ramped commit (start 50k tokens/day post‑pilot, 250k tokens/day by month 3). To make the economics work we included a tiered discount schedule in the attached quote tied to those commits. The price on RevB requires internal finance signoff for any discount above 20%.

Attachments: redwood_pilot_milestones_v3.pdf, quote_DEAL-8675_RevB.xlsx, MAP-timeline-annotated.png

Next steps:
- Confirm security checklist owner (we listed Anil from your infra team).
- If you’re comfortable with the milestones, we’ll finalize the DocuSign and route the discount approval internally.

Would you be available for a 30‑minute sync Thurs to finalize the timeline?

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0199

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 11:03 AM Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@bluebayanalytics.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the overview last week. We want to see a clean MAP and a firm path to production in Q3.
> — Carmen
From: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@bluebayanalytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot mileposts & preliminary commercial outline

Sergio —

Received, thanks. High level looks good. Two items from procurement and finance on our side:
1) They need a consolidated quote with a single effective discount if we commit to the 3‑month ramp target (we prefer a guaranteed stepped discount rather than a complicated ladder).
2) Our procurement will only sign off if any >25% discount is confirmed in writing with CFO approval from Redwood (internal policy).

If you can get that CFO‑level signoff for the conditional discount, procurement will fast‑track the PO.

Can we aim to have the final doc signed by next Tue?

—Carmen
Procurement Manager | BlueBay Analytics
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: BlueBay conditional >25% discount request (DEAL-8675) — need finance/CXO clearance

Team —

Quick background (copied from Carmen): procurement will only greenlight the PO if any discount over 25% has explicit CFO approval in writing. BlueBay is asking for a simple single effective discount contingent on hitting the ramp: if they meet the 250k tokens/day by month 3, they receive a 28% effective discount on hosted usage for the first 6 months post‑commit.

Attached: quote_DEAL-8675_RevB.xlsx (shows the 28% line), redwood_pilot_milestones_v3.pdf

My ask: can Finance/Legal confirm whether we can commit to a conditional 28% discount for the initial term, and if so, can we get a signed note from the CFO to satisfy their procurement? Procurement wants the CFO statement before routing the PO to legal.

Why it makes sense:
- BlueBay is a data‑native analytics platform with a 3‑year expansion profile; our estimates show $1.2M ARR at steady state if they ramp per the MAP.
- The pilot accelerates them to production by end of Q3; rapid reference potential in healthcare analytics vertical.

If helpful, I can circulate an abbreviated revenue waterfall to justify the concession. We’re on a tight cadence — Carmen wants this wrapped by next Tue.

Thanks,
Sergio
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BlueBay conditional >25% discount request (DEAL-8675) — need finance/CXO clearance

Sergio / Marissa —

Finance can sign off on a conditional commercial concession if we have the following:
1) A one‑page revenue projection (3 years) showing ARR and net present value at the proposed concession (Sergio, you referenced $1.2M — please attach the waterfall).
2) Contract language that ties the discount to measurable telemetry (we prefer a token‑based meter and an audit right after month 3).
3) Confirmation on revenue recognition (is revenue recognized on invoice date or performance milestone?).

If you can get me the projection and a redline snapshot of the discount clause (I can supply a templated CFO signoff language), I can route to Aditya for CFO confirmation. Timing: fastest path is 24 hours once we have those two artifacts.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BlueBay conditional >25% discount request (DEAL-8675) — need finance/CXO clearance

All —

I reviewed the preliminary numbers Laura requested. I’m comfortable providing a written CFO confirmation for a conditional 28% effective discount limited to the first six months post‑pilot under these constraints:
- We sign the standard SOW with the token meter and audit right.
- The 3‑month ramp target and telemetry are enforced in the MAP; failure to hit the target voids the concession prospectively.
- We include a clawback clause for over‑usage credits if there is artificial token inflation.

Sergio: please send the 3‑year revenue waterfall and the contract redline (Laura’s template applied). Once I have those I will provide the CFO‑level signoff email they require.

Aditya Rao
Chief Financial Officer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@bluebayanalytics.com>
Cc: gv-contracts@bluebayanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot mileposts & preliminary commercial outline

Carmen —

Thanks for the clarity. Finance is willing to provide a CFO confirmation for the conditional 28% effective discount for the first six months after pilot acceptance, subject to the telemetry and clawback language Laura requested. Aditya (CFO) asked us to finalize a 3‑year revenue waterfall and a redline of the discount clause — Laura will circulate the template and we’ll attach both to the DocuSign envelope.

Proposed next step: I’ll send the final quote + Aditya’s confirmation email and the DocuSign package by EOD Wed so procurement can route the PO on Thu. Can you confirm your legal receives DocuSign or if they prefer a PDF for countersignature?

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com

Attachments (sent): quote_DEAL-8675_RevB.xlsx, redwood_pilot_milestones_v3.pdf
